blend.note: a NEW emergent culture, neither Norse nor Aztec - blood-cult reavers of the jungle-and-glacier highlands; the tongue, titles and gods are fused forms sitting between the two parents, not backbone+overlay.

_note: Cross-family DEEP BLEND (Norse + Aztec): a single emergent people of the steaming jungle lowlands and the ice-capped volcanic peaks - reaver war-clans whose blood-cult fuses the berserker's frenzy and the offered heart. Not backbone+overlay: the lexicon, titles and deity-names are genuinely fused (Norse -r/th + Nahuatl -tl/tz). clan = clanhold. CHAOTIC ALONE. Common-word lexicon and rank titles fuse the real Norse/Nahuatl registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real gods.

phonology.palette: Fused Norse-Nahuatl: stops p t k, the dentals th/tl, affricates tz/ts, x (sh), hu/w, ku, glottal stop; nominative -r and absolutive -tl collide into fused endings -atl/-tr/-r; root-initial stress with Nahuatl penults.
phonology.phonotactics: CVC and the clusters tl/tz/kn/fj/ku; fused -atl/-tr endings; glottal stops.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -son (Norse) fused with the calendar-day name (Aztec); the aetpol (war-clan); a blood-deed war-name earned in the raid.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|animal](stem) + feature: Tlil-tepfjall (black-mountain), Chich-atoyr (red-river); the war-clan named for its blood-deed or its peak; -gard/-borg for the steadings.

title_ladder.government: clanhold (reaver war-clans of the high jungle: the war-king and his hird-society over the aetpol clans; the blood-council raises the war-king)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Fused Norse-Nahuatl clanhold, ascending; the titles blend the two (Norse jarl/konungr + Aztec tecuhtli/tlatoani). Hertekw (war-lord) barony; Yaomark (border war-chief) march; Tecujarl (lord) county; Tlacafylk (war-leader) duchy; Kontlatl (war-king) principality; Hueykonr (great war-king) kingdom; Cemkonr (the all-war-king) empire over Cem-Huitzgard. The blood-council and the warrior-societies check the war-kings. (Rank titles fuse the real Norse/Nahuatl register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: a calendar-day birth-name, replaced at the first kill by a blood-deed war-name; the aetpol (war-clan); a society-honor for the renowned.
people_name_convention.dual_register: war-kings and society-warriors bear blood-deed names and honors; others a day-name + clan.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the war-fire and blood powers: Marah- (war-fire), -tletl (fire), Eztli- (blood), Yao- (war): e.g. Marah-son, Eztli-coatl.

religion._note: Deity-names are fused morphs of the Agrippan canon (Norse + Nahuatl), never real gods. Huitzilan is Chaotic alone: a blood-cult that venerates the Chaotic powers - chief among them Marahtl, the War-Fire and Blood-Sun that must be fed - and DEMONIZES the One (Eitnatl) and the Lawful powers as the cold sky-tyrants. The frenzy of the berserker and the offered heart are one rite; the teoharg (blood-temple) atop the peak and the skull-rack are the altars.
religion.the_one: Eitnatl (< Aeternus; fused Norse Eitnir / Nahuatl Aiternatl) - REVILED as the cold Tyrant-Sun that would starve the world of blood; cursed, never revered

sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Marahtl (the War-Fire, the Blood-Sun that must be fed; chief of the venerated powers)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the One and the Lawful powers are the enemy-gods, named with dread: Aeternus -> Eitnatl the Tyrant-Sun (the chief enemy); Tulrius -> Tholatl the Cold-Sun; Orlandus -> Orlantr the Soft-Oath; Numeno -> Numentr the Idle-Word.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Teoharg (blood-temple) atop the tepfjall (peak) of [power], crowned by the skull-rack: 'the Teoharg of Marahtl'.
religion.saints_pattern: fallen war-kings and the greatest reavers become sun-feeding storm-riders; honored at the skull-rack and the burial-howe.

holy_symbol_motifs.Marahtl: an obsidian-edged sword over a blood-fed sun
holy_symbol_motifs.Wakitr: an open maw of ice swallowing a star
holy_symbol_motifs.Lusankr: a feathered serpent coiled over a hoard

banks_patterns.ships: reaver-longships that raid the jungle coasts: 'Blood-Wake', 'the Obsidian Prow', 'the Ice-Serpent'
banks_patterns.military_units: the warrior-societies: the [animal] berserkir / the [war-king] hird: 'the Jaguar-coats', 'the Eagle-hird'
banks_patterns.taverns: the war-hall and the octli-pit: 'the Skull-Hall', 'the Blood-Mead Pit'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: blood-temples gone cold and ice-locked war-camps: 'the Teoharg of [name]', 'the Frozen Gard of [war-king]'
